notes.title: Update 75
notes.content:
1. Normal enemies now gain a "hit" state, making them unable to move for 0.4 seconds when struck.  
2. Fixed some bugs.

notes.title: Update 74
notes.content: 1. Further optimized the game; frame rates should now be more stable. The hardware requirements have been lowered. If you encounter any issues, please post a report.

notes.title: Update #73 (New Content)
notes.content:
1. Enabled the **Item Codex** feature, allowing players to view all currently available dropable items in the game. Hovering over an item will display its basic details.  
2. Players can view all items or use the sidebar to filter by category.  
3. Weapons have a **secondary filter**, allowing selection by weapon type.

notes.title: Update 72 (New Content)
notes.content:
1. Added Codex Feature  
The "Talent Codex" is now available, allowing players to view all talents, including unlocked and locked talents.

notes.title: Update 71
notes.content:
1. Random talents, talent energy values, and unclaimed talents are now saved upon exiting the game. They will only be cleared upon death.  
2. Talents stolen by enemies are now saved when exiting the game and will be cleared upon player death.  
3. The settings menu when exiting the game now pauses the game.

notes.title: Update 70 (New Content)
notes.content:
1. Added new active skill: **Arc**  
2. Added new ancient gem: **Dancing Sparks**  

### Skill Description:  
A bolt of lightning arcs from the caster to a target in front, then chains to other nearby enemies but does not immediately chain back to the original target. Each time the primary arc chains, it also releases a secondary arc toward another enemy that the primary arc has not yet hit. Secondary arcs cannot chain further. Maximum of 16 chains.  

### Gem Exclusive Bonuses:  
- **Arc** gains +1 additional chain.  
- **Arc** releases 2 secondary arcs with each chain.

notes.title: Update #69 (New Content)
notes.content:
New Block Counterattack Skill: "Divine Retribution"

Skill Description:

Triggers a counterattack on block, unleashing a surge of divine energy that emits multiple lightning waves expanding outward from the target. This skill cannot be triggered and cannot be used by totems, traps, or mines.
Deals additional physical damage.
Converts 50% of physical damage to lightning damage.
Initially unavailable by default.
Explosion radius scales with skill level.
Creates 4 shockwaves.
Each shockwave erupts 6 times.
Has a long cooldown, making it a complementary skill for other block counterattack abilities.

notes.title: Update 66 (New Content)
notes.content:

notes.title: Update #63
notes.content: 1. Overall optimization completed, the game can now stably run at 60 FPS or higher.

notes.title: Update #62 (New Content)
notes.content:
1. Added a new dropped item, "Reincarnation Stone," which grants 1-3 Reincarnation Coins upon use.  
2. Added a new dropped item, "Reincarnation Crystal," which grants 3-6 Reincarnation Coins upon use.  
Reincarnation Coins are the currency used in the Reincarnation Shop and can be spent to purchase items sold by other players.

notes.title: Update #61 (Major Update)
notes.content:
1. Added the Reincarnation Market, where players can sell items. The market uses a separate currency, with each account starting with 50.  
   Currently, the new currency cannot be obtained through drops, but an update will be released in the coming days.  
2. Fixed some bugs.

notes.title: Version 60 Update (Preparatory Update)
notes.content:
1. Updated the item storage standards.  
2. Added a built-in database.  

These two updates are preparatory for the upcoming "Reincarnation Shop" feature.  
The Reincarnation Shop will allow players to trade items with each other, functioning like an auction house.

notes.title: 59 Update (New Content)

PS: The exclusive drops for the second map are still in production.

notes.title: 58 Update (New Content)

notes.title: 54th Update (New Language Support)
notes.content:
1.New English Support
However, my English is not very good, just at a high school level. Since I’m making the game alone and don’t have the money to hire a translator, I can only learn game-related English while working on it with GPT. So, there will definitely be some translation issues. I can only adjust it step by step. If there are any issues, feel free to leave a message and I’ll make corrections immediately. Thanks for the support.
